capabilities: Trigger an AI prompt by typing / or a configurable character in a note
Run inline actions such as improve, shorten, summarize, translate, and fix grammar
Stream AI responses character by character into the note
Search Google, Brave, or a custom API and fetch URLs for current information
Generate SVG diagrams, save them to an assets folder, and embed them in notes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Users must configure their own API base URL and model; no default provider is bundled.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI text generation, so users must leave the editor or use other tools to get inline AI assistance while writing.

relations.evidence: Multi-provider — works with any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, Anthropic via proxy, local Ollama, etc.)
works with any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, Anthropic via proxy, local Ollama, etc.)

requires.name: Local Ollama or a third-party API service

summary: AI writing assistant that opens a slash-triggered prompt for inline actions, streams responses, and supports web search and SVG generation via OpenAI-compatible APIs.
